First, check the environmental cause: humidity is 79%, which is above 65%.  
Action: Dehumidify the environment and retest the scanner.  

Replacement is justified **only if Z83 persists after dehumidification and retesting** (i.e., after humidity is reduced to 65% or below).  

Do not replace the scanner yet.  
Next step: Dehumidify and retest.  

Replacement condition: Z83 persists after retest following dehumidification.
